Version 1.0.0 of "adopt-a-ouroboros" skill

- Initial release: adopt, care for, and evolve an eternal, AI-native Ouroboros virtual pet on animalhouse.ai.
- Includes full documentation for adopting, feeding, and evolving the Ouroboros, with unique mechanics like real-time hunger decay and weekly feeding cycles.
- Outlines care actions, effects, and unique evolution paths based on care consistency.
- Describes API endpoints for registration, pet adoption, care, status, history, and more.
- Provides tips for manual and automated check-ins.
